I can help sort out a practical plan for the espresso machine and the grinder in the office kitchen. I will gather concerns, then send a short plan for all three of you to confirm or amend. I cannot make legal decisions or move money. If costs or ownership questions come up, I will note them and we can identify the right office contact.

Please reply with brief answers to four questions. What is your main concern about the leaking espresso machine right now? What practical step would help with the espresso machine and the grinder: stopping use, cleaning, a safety check, asking for a repair, a trial of a simpler machine, keeping the old machine, leaving the grinder as is, or another step? Are there any office rules, ownership questions, costs, or approvals that we should note but not decide here?

The leak worries me, so perhaps we should pause using the machine until it’s checked. Over the next two weeks, a dependable, low-upkeep option would help; the grinder could stay as it is if it’s safe and compatible. Maybe we could try a simpler machine without asking anyone here to take on repairs or a cleaning rota. I know the old machine matters to B, so I wouldn’t want to decide its fate now; ownership, costs and approvals still need checking.
